thread:
olivia_csm: FYI — onboarding for a small set of VPC trial tenants is failing during token refresh (noticed ~08:05 UTC). Drafting customer notes and need finance + ops signoff for a one-week goodwill credit. Incident INC-2025-872. @jamal_support @steve_eng please confirm cause and ETA.
jamal_support: Repro confirmed. Refresh endpoint returns 401 when refresh_window == 0 due to a boundary check regression. Log: `auth.refresh tenant=tn-721 status=401 window=0`. Repro: create tenant -> trigger refresh -> 401 at /v1/auth/refresh.
steve_eng: Root cause identified. Hotfix: revert the offending check, add boundary unit test, canary in us-west-2 at 08:40 UTC, full rollout target 09:20 UTC. Will post status update once canary is green.
incident-bot: INC-2025-872 | created | severity: high | impacted: ~37 new VPC trial tenants | status: investigating
liam_csm: Data check: 8 impacted tenants expire within 30 days; 3 marked high-touch/renewal-risk. Recommend prioritized outreach to those 8 and dedicated handoff for the 3.
maria_finance: Finance ack: one-week trial credit for affected tenants approved under goodwill policy. Tag credits with incident code for tracking.
sam_ops: I can flip an internal relax-refresh flag per-tenant to reduce churn while the rollback deploys. Enabling for the cohort now; paste the 8 near-expiry IDs if you want them prioritized.
olivia_csm: Draft short trial message: "Hi — we're investigating an authentication issue affecting onboarding for a subset of new VPC tenants. Engineers are rolling a fix; we expect service to be restored within ~60 minutes. Affected trials will receive a one-week credit and an offer for a 1:1 enablement session. Sorry for the disruption. — Olivia, Redwood CSM"

olivia_csm: Exec draft for renewal-risk accounts: "Hello — we’re reaching out proactively. During onboarding some VPC trials experienced authentication failures. Engineers are deploying a fix and we expect full availability shortly. To reduce impact we will: (1) apply a one-week usage credit, (2) schedule a 30-min enablement session within 3 business days, and (3) assign a CS lead for direct coordination. We will follow up with an RCA and short impact survey. Reply with preferred times for a call. — Olivia"
steve_eng: After rollback we'll publish a short ops postmortem and link it in the follow-up. Target public status update by ~09:30 UTC.
jamal_support: Support macro ready for immediate responses and a small workaround to share: re-run the onboarding job or rotate the onboarding token via Console. Example sanitized retry curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/onboard/retry -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"tenant_id":"tn-721"}'`
olivia_csm: Final plan: wait for Sam confirm flag flip and for Steve to confirm canary health; then send trial blast and exec notes for prioritized list. I'll DM the 8 IDs and start scheduling 1:1s for responders. Thanks all.
